function.name: court_info_get_case_status
function.description: Retrieves the status and trial dates for court cases from specified county courts. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.reasoning:
The user asks: "案件編號XY1234在Los Angeles County Court和案件編號GH5678在Orange County Court的狀態和預定審判日期是什麼？" They want status and trial date for two cases. We need to call the function twice: one for each case. The function signature: court_info_get_case_status with case_number, court, details optional. We need both status and trial_date. We can call twice with details='status' and details='trial_date', or maybe we can call once with default? The default is 'status', so we need to call twice for each case. But maybe we can call once for status and once for trial_date. The user wants both. So we need to call function twice per case. That is 4 calls. But maybe we can combine? The function only returns one detail at a time. So we need 4 calls.

We should do them sequentially. We'll call for XY1234 Los Angeles County Court status, then XY1234 Los Angeles County Court trial_date, then GH5678 Orange County Court status, then GH5678 Orange County Court trial_date.

We need to output the results after calls. We'll use the function calls.
